text:
My mother's crown came loose, so we made an appointment with a dentist at this clinic to see what could be done. During the first examination, the dentist said it looked like the crown had simply come off, and there was no decay. Later, they took an X-ray and said the tooth root was shallow and weak, requiring extraction and a denture, as repairs weren't guaranteed to last. My mother and I weren't prepared for extraction, so we asked if we could have a tartar removal first, and said we'd think about the extraction later. The dentist became hesitant and even said to us, "At your age, you don't need to focus on aesthetics, just function." My mother and I were speechless. We weren't concerned about beauty; we just wanted to be able to chew properly and maintain good oral health. The dentist didn't need to say that.

In short, we decided not to proceed, only paying for the X-ray. The next day, we went to another clinic. The dentist there said it was just a loose crown, no decay or problems, and that a new crown would suffice. To this day, that tooth remains healthy. I want to warn everyone: always consider the reasons and explanations before undergoing any treatment from your dentist. Because once the procedure is done and the tooth is gone, you can't get it back.

Edited: The clinic owner, Dr. Wirin, called to inquire about what happened that day. Thank you very much, Dr. Wirin, for your attentiveness and concern for the patient's feelings. Some doctors within the clinic may not fully understand the patients' needs, but overall, the clinic's management is excellent. The front desk staff are kind and polite, as is the clinic owner.
